basics.name: Dana Okonkwo
basics.label: Mechanical & Design Engineer
basics.summary: Mechanical engineer working on single-use medical devices from first sketch to tooling release; EU patent holder. Spent three years on the clean-room floor before moving to design, which is why the tolerances are buildable.

work.name: Hydra Medical
highlights: Led the dose-counter redesign on an inhaler running 400,000 units a year; cut the part count from nine to five.
Built the drop and cycle test rig the team now uses for design verification, and wrote the test protocols that go with it.
Qualified two moulding suppliers, one in Portugal and one in Poland, and ran the first-article inspections.

work.name: Polytechnic Prototyping Lab
highlights: Ran a seven-machine prototyping shop: four FDM printers, a resin printer, a benchtop mill and a laser cutter.
Taught the machine-safety induction to about 120 students a year and wrote the handbook for it.

publications.name: Dose-counting mechanism for a metered inhaler
